title: Mood-color associations in anxiety and depression
statement:
Individuals with anxiety or depression more frequently associate their mood with grey shades, while healthy individuals more often associate mood with yellow.

Options:
- Positive mood yellow: #FFD700 soft yellow (fits: wellness, optimistic)
- Neutral-to-negative grey: #808080 mid-grey (fits: avoid for mood support)
- Calm favourite blue: #87CEEB sky blue (fits: mental health app)
- Restorative green: #90EE90 light green (fits: recovery, balance)
appliesWhen: Applies to: health. Audience: adults, seniors.

source.title: The Manchester Color Wheel: development of a novel way of identifying color choice and its validation in healthy, anxious and depressed individuals
source.authors: Helen R. Carruthers; Julie Morris; Nicholas Tarrier; Peter J. Whorwell
